tasks.original_prompt:
Anemia follow-up: from the first low hemoglobin in the current run, was a repeat drawn, what did it show, and is the most recent value still low?
Context: patient MRN SYN-140f92ccca (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-04-21, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"low": ..., "rechecked": ..., "recheck": ..., "recheck_ordered": ..., "latest": ..., "still_low": ...}. low is the first result of the most recent run of consecutive low results, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). rechecked (boolean) is whether any result is dated after low. recheck is the first result after low (same keys), and recheck_ordered (YYYY-MM-DD) the authoredOn date of the ServiceRequest its basedOn references; both null when not rechecked. latest is the most recent result (same keys) and still_low (boolean) whether it is low. Every field is null when no result is low. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (low, the recheck and its ServiceRequest, and latest; when no result is low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

For this patient's hypertension: date of the most recent blood pressure, days since then, and the home medications for that condition.
Context: patient MRN SYN-140f92ccca (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-03-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The condition is the Condition whose code.text contains 'hypertension' (case-insensitive) and none of: history of, gestational, pregnan, insipidus, prediabet, pre-diabet, pulmonary, portal, intracranial, ocular, neonatal. The monitoring test is blood pressure (LOINC 85354-9). answer is {"condition": ..., "last_test_date": ..., "days_since": ..., "treatments": [...]}. condition (string) is that Condition's code.text; last_test_date (YYYY-MM-DD) is the effective date of the most recent Observation of that test with status final or corrected on or before the as-of date, and days_since (integer) the days from it to the as-of date, both null when there is none; treatments lists, sorted, the medicationCodeableConcept.text of every MedicationStatement with status active whose text contains any of: lisinopril, enalapril, ramipril, benazepril, losartan, valsartan, irbesartan, olmesartan, amlodipine, nifedipine, diltiazem, hydrochlorothiazide, chlorthalidone, metoprolol, atenolol, carvedilol, spironolactone (case-insensitive). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Condition, the most recent test result and each listed MedicationStatement); when there is no result, the answer must also rest on a search of this patient's Observations filtered by patient and code (only _count may be added) that returns no records, using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.
